Name: Valley Link - Global Chat
Author: xzqute
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/BdSG3NI.png[/img][/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.1.0+-brightgreen.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Steam-Required-1b2838.svg[/img] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/GMCM-Optional-purple.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Backend-Serverless-lightgrey.svg[/img]
 [/center]
[center][size=4]Chat with other Stardew Valley players across different farms, saves, years, and multiplayer sessions, all through Steam lobbies. [/size][size=4]It runs inside the game's normal chat box. No account, no dedicated ValleyLink server, nothing else to set up.[/size]
 [/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/t5cxSOz.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=4][b]One chat box. Every farm.[/b][/size][/center]

[heading][size=5]Features[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Cross-save global chat:[/b] Talk to other ValleyLink players even if they're on a completely different farm, save, year, or game mode than you.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Vanilla chat integration:[/b] It's the same chat box you already use, not a separate window or overlay bolted on top.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Lobby browser:[/b] Press F8 to browse worldwide Global, a language-specific lobby, or a player-created room.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Player-created rooms:[/b] Make a public, friends-only, private, or unlisted room, with room for up to 250 players.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Encrypted rooms:[/b] Unlisted rooms can be end-to-end encrypted and gated behind a private VLE- invite code.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Multi-script chat:[/b] Mix Cyrillic, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, and other scripts, anything Stardew's bundled fonts support, in one message.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Local safety tools:[/b] Mute or block players, filter profanity, suppress repeat spam, and hide unverified links.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Custom identity:[/b] Chat under your farmer name or a custom nickname, in one of nine colors.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]No accounts, no telemetry:[/b] There's no ValleyLink account, no dedicated backend, and nothing about Stardew Valley's multiplayer transport gets touched.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]GMCM support:[/b] Configure everything in-game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Languages:[/b] The interface is in English. Language lobbies and profanity filtering cover all 12 languages Stardew Valley ships with.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]How to use[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Load a save and press [b]F8[/b] to open the ValleyLink lobby browser.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Join worldwide Global, a language lobby, a player room, or enter an invite code.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Open the game's normal chat box and type like you always do.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]While the chat input is open, press [b]Tab[/b] to switch between [b][G] Global[/b] and [b][L] Local[/b] farm chat.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Use [b]/g message[/b] to send directly to your active ValleyLink lobby, or [b]/r message[/b] explicitly when using a player-created room.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Type [b]/vl help[/b] for the full command list. Useful ones: [b]/vl rooms[/b], [b]/vl join <code>[/b], [b]/vl leave[/b], [b]/vl code[/b], [b]/vl who[/b], [b]/vl mute <name>[/b], [b]/vl block <name>[/b], and [b]/vl clear[/b].[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Rooms and invite codes[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]A normal [b]VL-[/b] code just points to a Steam lobby. It doesn't override that lobby's privacy settings, capacity, or Steam's own access checks.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Encrypted rooms use a longer [b]VLE-[/b] code that carries the room's encryption key itself. That key is never written to disk or placed in Steam's lobby metadata.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Only share a complete VLE- code somewhere private and trusted.[/b] Whoever has the full code can read and post in that room, no other check involved.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Encrypted rooms use AES-256-GCM. That's solid enough to keep casual eavesdroppers out, but it doesn't give you forward secrecy, per-member keys, or automatic rekeying when someone leaves. If you need to rotate the key, spin up a new room.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Make sure you're on the Steam desktop version of Stardew Valley, and that Steam itself is running and signed in.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download ValleyLink and extract the [b]ValleyLink[/b] folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch the game through SMAPI, load a save, and press [b]F8[/b].[/size][/*]
[*][size=4](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Updating and uninstalling[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Update:[/b] Delete the old [i]Mods/ValleyLink[/i] folder and extract the new one in its place. Your config lives locally, so back it up first if you want to keep your settings.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Uninstall:[/b] Just delete the [i]Mods/ValleyLink[/i] folder. ValleyLink never touches your save files, and there's no server-side account or message history left behind to clean up.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Configuration[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Enabled[/b] - Turns ValleyLink's online chat and lobby controls on or off entirely. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Open lobby browser[/b] - Keybind for the lobby browser. Default: F8.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Use farmer name[/b] - Shows your farmer's name instead of a custom nickname. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Custom nickname[/b] - The name shown when farmer-name mode is off. Default: Empty.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Nickname color[/b] - Blue, cyan, green, orange, pink, purple, red, yellow, or white. Default: Blue.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Preferred language[/b] - The language selected by default when creating a lobby. It won't auto-join you to a language lobby. Default: English.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Global join/leave messages[/b] - Show join and leave notices in Global and language lobbies. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]User-lobby join/leave messages[/b] - Show join and leave notices in player-created rooms. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Profanity filter[/b] - Masks matched words in ValleyLink chat, sent and received. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Privacy and safety[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Chat travels through Steam's own lobby infrastructure, so Steam can see who's in a lobby, when messages go out, and about how big they are.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]What it doesn't send: save paths, IP addresses, computer names, in-game coordinates, your mod list, machine IDs, or any analytics.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]All moderation happens on your own machine. There's no central moderation database anywhere, so muting, blocking, or filtering someone only changes what you see, not what anyone else sees.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Web links, bare domains, IP-address links, and custom URL schemes get replaced with a local warning in ValleyLink channels.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Turning off the profanity filter means you'll see whatever people type, including offensive content. Link protection stays on regardless.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Stardew Valley 1.6.x, desktop, through Steam.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Steam needs to be running and connected for chat to work. Without it, the mod still loads fine, you just won't have any messaging.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works in both single-player and multiplayer without replacing Stardew Valley's normal farm chat.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]No required dependencies besides SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]GOG is not supported as an online transport fallback.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Known limitations[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Each active channel only keeps the last 100 messages in memory. Nothing gets saved to disk, and anyone who joins later won't see what they missed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Messages are limited to 255 Unicode characters.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]If Stardew's own multiplayer is already using Steam's regular-lobby slot, friends-only and private rooms may not be available. ValleyLink won't disconnect or take over the game's lobby to make room.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Scripts outside Stardew Valley's bundled fonts fall back to a safe default. Use the game's own emoji picker for Stardew sprite emoji.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Troubleshooting[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Steam unavailable:[/b] Start Steam in online mode, launch the Steam copy of Stardew Valley through SMAPI, and load a save.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Need normal farm chat:[/b] Open chat and press [b]Tab[/b] until the input prefix changes to [b][L] Local[/b].[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Cannot join a room:[/b] It may be full, private, expired, incompatible, or blocked by Steam's regular-lobby limit.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]No rooms shown:[/b] Open the lobby browser and choose Refresh.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Run [b]valleylink_status[/b] in the SMAPI console, or [b]/vl status[/b] in chat, for connection details.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Credits[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Profanity dictionaries:[/b] [url=https://github.com/LDNOOBWV2/List-of-Dirty-Naughty-Obscene-and-Otherwise-Bad-Words_V2]List-of-Dirty-Naughty-Obscene-and-Otherwise-Bad-Words_V2[/url], provided under CC0 1.0 Universal.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]
